product_name: Bajaj Life Guaranteed Pension Goal II
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual/Group General Annuity Plan
key_benefits: Guaranteed lifelong annuity income; annuity amount is guaranteed at policy inception and paid at the chosen frequency (Yearly/Half-yearly/Quarterly/Monthly)
Immediate Annuity: annuity payable in arrears from inception; Deferred Annuity: annuity payable from the end of the chosen deferment period
Option B: Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price (ROP, 50%-100% chosen at inception) on death
Option C: Annuity certain (5/10/15/20 years) and life thereafter
Option D/E: Joint Life Last Survivor with 50% or 100% annuity to spouse
Option F: Joint Life Last Survivor with 100% annuity to spouse and ROP on death of last survivor
Option G: Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price on death or survival
Policy loan available (up to 80% of Surrender Value once acquired)

eligibility.policy_term: Whole-life annuity (immediate) / deferment period chosen at inception (deferred)
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single Premium, or Regular/Limited Premium (deferred annuity); annuity option once chosen at inception cannot be changed
eligibility.note: Entry-age and minimum/maximum purchase-price ranges are referenced in the brochure but specific numeric values were not recovered from this parse. For QROPS / NPS-corpus / HMRC-governed purchases, entry-age rules differ.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document. For QROPS purchases, free-look cancellation proceeds are only transferred back per the applicable rules.
key_terms.grace_period: Grace period applies; on non-payment within the grace period a deferred annuity is converted to paid-up (exact days not isolated from parse).
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death of the Annuitant (or last survivor in a joint-life policy) due to suicide within 12 months from commencement/revival (whichever is later), the higher of 80% of Total Premiums Paid or the Surrender Value as on the date of death is payable. Under a deferred annuity during the annuity period or an immediate annuity, the suicide clause does not apply. No exclusions other than the suicide clause.
key_terms.guaranteed_benefit_note: The annuity amount is guaranteed at inception and depends on the purchase price and the annuity option chosen ('Conditions Apply'). Return of Purchase Price proportion (50%-100%) is chosen at inception and cannot be changed.
key_terms.surrender_note: Surrender Value applies to certain options (e.g. ROP / Annuity-Certain options). Immediate Annuity: Special Surrender Value; Deferred: higher of GSV or SSV during deferment, SSV after.
key_terms.loan_note: Policy loan available once a Surrender Value is acquired; maximum loan up to 80% of Surrender Value; outstanding loan plus interest deducted from death/surrender value.
key_terms.tax_note: GST / tax as per prevailing tax laws, subject to amendment.

mandatory_disclosures_present: 'Conditions Apply' caveat on the guaranteed-income headline

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'guaranteed income for life' claim must carry the 'Conditions Apply — depends on purchase price and annuity option chosen' caveat present in the brochure.
Return of Purchase Price (ROP) is variant/option-specific (Options B, F, G) and the percentage (50%-100%) is chosen at inception — any 'get your money back' claim must be option-qualified.
Joint-life / spouse-continuation benefits apply ONLY to the joint-life options (D, E, F).
Annuity-certain payout (Option C) is for the chosen 5/10/15/20-year guaranteed period.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT present this as a market-linked / wealth-creation or growth product — it is a non-linked, non-participating annuity that pays a fixed guaranteed income.
Do NOT use 'bonus' language — the plan is non-participating.
Do NOT imply the annuity rate is the same for everyone — the annuity amount varies by option, purchase price, age and frequency.
Do NOT promise return of the full purchase price unconditionally — ROP only applies under specific options and at the chosen percentage.
Do NOT omit that the annuity option, once chosen at inception, cannot be changed during the policy term.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor (Non-Linked, Non-Participating Annuity Plan)
'Conditions Apply' caveat for the guaranteed-income claim (dependent on purchase price and annuity option)
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document / benefit illustration for full terms and exclusions

gaps: Verbatim one-line IRDAI descriptor not isolated by the parser; reconstructed from product type (non-linked, non-participating annuity; available on both individual and group basis) — verify exact wording against the policy document.
